description:
Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning types. The x-axis is labeled "epoch", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 6, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "WER", has a linear scale, ranges from 24 to 42.5, and has tick labels at intervals of 2.5. A yellow solid line with circular markers represents "small AdaLoRA_int4", starting at approximately 36.5 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 26 at epoch 6. A yellow dashed line with square markers represents "small AdaLoRA_int8", beginning at approximately 33 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 24 at epoch 6. A yellow solid line with diamond markers represents "small int4", starting at approximately 41 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 28 at epoch 6. A yellow dashed line with triangular markers represents "small int8", beginning at approximately 30.5 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 25.5 at epoch 6.
